name: Almonds
description: The prized nut of badam milk and Unani tonics.

ayurveda.note: Heating — but soaked & peeled becomes neutral-building, per classical rule.

unani.note: Badam is garam; sardai (soaked-ground) tempers it.

nutrition.highlight: vitamin E, and soaked overnight in half of Asia

effects.note: A 20-week trial of 175 adults with poor sleep found that 60g of almonds a day improved self-reported sleep quality, efficiency and time to fall asleep, with a modest rise in blood melatonin — though objective sleep-lab measures showed no change. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
